_comment: Bullets Grayson wrote about the same roles in EARLIER resume iterations, kept as raw material for rewriting rather than as things to print. Each entry is his own prior wording, so the generator can vary emphasis and vocabulary without inventing anything. Provenance is recorded because these age: a 2020 phrasing of a role he held until 2021 is still his, but the 2025 canonical record in resume-facts.json is what governs titles, dates and employers. NOTHING from an internship or a role absent from resume-facts.json belongs in here, so the generator cannot borrow an internship achievement into a full-time role. LinkedIn is represented by a profile export. Only roles that exist in resume-facts.json are carried over from it: the internships and the early ventures on that profile deliberately have no entry here.

_writeupSlugs_comment: Write-ups that belong to a role but carry no `org` frontmatter, because the employer was his own company. The org matching in build-kb.mjs cannot find these, so they are named here.
_profile_comment: The LinkedIn summary and its skills taxonomy. Not attached to any one role and never printed: it is there so the generator can see how he positions himself and which technology names he actually uses, rather than inferring a register from bullets alone.
